items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: What got me back was Lou Irwin. Lou got a part for me to do in a picture, the Bill Robinson Story... Lou Irwin did one for me, he booked me on a show with Jerome Kern

ctx.x: Do you know what he did these steps that you taught him in?
No, in his dancing when he got around to it, I guess.
I told you about coming from overseas, 'bout Lou Irwin bringing me back from Germany to do the part of Bill Robinson and the first (inaudible) of the 20th Century.
